name: NHanced Semiconductors, Inc.
old_description: Turning revolutionary ideas into unique devices takes a talented, creative team:
about:
NHanced Semiconductors, Inc. operates from three U.S. locations: Batavia, Illinois; Morrisville, North Carolina; and Odon, Indiana. The company is U.S.-based and U.S.-owned, and it is ITAR registered. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The company provides end-to-end semiconductor services spanning design, back-end-of-line (BEoL) fabrication, advanced packaging, assembly, and test. Its Class 100 cleanrooms run full semiconductor processing lines for unit processes, modules, and turnkey wafer projects. Core capabilities include 2.5D and 3D integration, hybrid bonding, chiplet assembly, heterogeneous integration, additive silicon manufacturing, photonics, microfluidics, and III‑V compound semiconductors. The Foundry 2.0 model emphasizes flexible manufacturing lines that accommodate prototype through full‑production volumes, with a focus on high‑mix, low‑ to medium‑volume runs.

NHanced serves industrial, medical, military, and scientific markets. Customers bring designs for specialized sensors, FPGAs, SerDes, memory chips (DRAM, MRAM, RRAM), ASICs, and AI systems. The firm tailors each process step for custom silicon sensors and welcomes experimental devices and small lots.

NHanced states it has delivered more distinct hybrid‑bonded projects than any other provider worldwide. Its team averages over 20 years of experience, and the company earned the 2024 3D InCites Award for Best Place to Work in Microelectronics. The business was built to address smaller market segments that need cost‑effective, high‑mix manufacturing at low and medium volumes.
